plan.summary: Low cash-flow predictability → comps primary, DCF cross-check.

methods.name: Public Comps: Sector Peers
methods.reason: low cash-flow predictability: current multiples (EV/Sales, EV/EBITDA) anchor better than distant cash flows

methods.name: DCF (Standalone)
methods.reason: tests whether the multiple is supported by plausible long-run cash flows

methods.name: DCF with Synergies
methods.reason: value to a buyer, synergies included: an offer price, not a standalone value

methods.name: Just Synergies
methods.reason: pre-announcement price plus the synergies: an offer price, not a standalone value

methods.name: LBO
methods.reason: what a financial buyer could pay given the cash flows and debt capacity

methods.name: Precedent Transactions
methods.reason: includes a control premium; not a standalone value

headlines.answer: ORCL is worth about $-41.16 a share (range $-50.51–$-35.53).
